cohort_filter: ICD N18.* (chronic kidney disease) on hospital admissions, with required ED + discharge-note modalities
description: 18 structured csv files (7 top-level + 4 icu + 6 multimodal/ed + 1 multimodal/notes). Split key is SUBJECT_ID (10 train / 20 val / 2970 test): subject-disjoint guarantees train/val/test are fully disjoint at subject / hadm / stay / ed_stay / note granularity, so ref ⊆ raw for every modality. cohort.csv is one row per hadm_id (subject_id + hadm_id composite key) and is sliced by hadm_id via hadm→subject mapping. 4 cohort.csv columns are agent-derived: cohort_type/cohort_label/icd_root (from ICD N18 filter) + hospital_expire_flag (copy from admissions). demographics.csv carries 6 columns fully aligned with raw hosp/patients.csv; anchor_year_group is the agent-derived 5-year bucket. ED modality (6 tables) is sliced by subject_id directly because every ED table carries subject_id. notes.csv is the merge of note/{discharge, radiology} parent rows (sliced by hadm_id) + note/{discharge_detail, radiology_detail} detail rows (sliced by note_id collected from parent). scorer grades all 18 via equal_file_row_aligned_v1. summary.json is metadata only and is intentionally NOT copied into reference/ (the harness walks reference/ recursively and would fail load_evaluation_manifest's key_columns check on summary.json).

admissions.csv.notes: 13 columns: ref ⊂ raw (raw hosp/admissions.csv.gz has 16 columns; ref drops admit_provider_id/edregtime/edouttime). One row per hadm_id.

cohort.csv.notes: cohort table; one row per (subject_id, hadm_id) that has at least one ICD N18.* diagnosis. 6 columns: subject_id+hadm_id from admissions; cohort_type/cohort_label/icd_root/hospital_expire_flag are agent-derived. In N18 train these 4 derived columns are constant per row (cohort_type='disease_with_required_modality', cohort_label='N18', icd_root='N18'), so the agent must NOT rely on raw to populate them — must derive from ICD filter on diagnoses_icd + value copy from admissions.

demographics.csv.notes: 6 columns fully aligned with raw hosp/patients.csv: subject_id+gender+anchor_age+anchor_year+anchor_year_group+dod. Sliced by subject_id (subject-level split ⇒ one row per split, no cross-split duplicates). anchor_year_group is a 5-year bucket string derived from anchor_year (agent must derive: e.g. anchor_year 2138 → '2011 - 2013' per MIMIC-IV de-identification rules).

medications.csv.notes: All 8 columns used as composite key. Ref ⊂ raw (raw hosp/prescriptions.csv.gz has ~14 columns; ref drops pharmacy_id, formulary_drug_code, etc.).

labs.csv.notes: 6 columns: ref ⊂ raw (raw hosp/labevents.csv.gz has 15 columns; ref drops labevent_id, specimen_id, order_provider_id, storetime, value, ref_range_lower, ref_range_upper, flag, priority, comments).

icu/icustays.csv.notes: 7 columns: subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id, intime, outtime, los. Ref drops first_careunit, last_careunit from raw.

icu/chartevents.csv.notes: 7 columns as composite key. Ref ⊂ raw (raw icu/chartevents.csv.gz drops caregiver_id, storetime, value, warning).

icu/inputevents.csv.notes: 7 columns as composite key. Ref ⊂ raw (raw drops caregiver_id, orderid, linkorderid, ordercategoryname, secondaryordercategoryname, totalamount, totalamountuom, rate, rateuom, etc.).

icu/outputevents.csv.notes: 6 columns as composite key. Ref ⊂ raw (raw drops caregiver_id).

multimodal/edstays.csv.notes: 9 columns: subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id, intime, outtime, gender, race, arrival_transport, disposition. All 9 columns IDENTICAL to raw mimiciv_ed/edstays.csv (N18 carries gender/race/arrival_transport/disposition as separate columns). Sliced by subject_id directly. WARNING: raw hadm_id is stored as float string (e.g. '20642784.0'); agent must strip the '.0' to match ref. Sliced by subject_id (subject-level split ⇒ ref ⊆ raw; some ED stays in raw may not be in ref if the subject has non-cohort ED visits — agent must keep all ED rows that exist for cohort subjects).

multimodal/ed_diagnosis.csv.notes: 6 columns including icd_title (ref adds icd_title on top of raw mimiciv_ed/diagnosis.csv). Sliced by subject_id.

multimodal/ed_triage.csv.notes: 11 columns: temperature, heartrate, resprate, o2sat, sbp, dbp, pain, acuity, chiefcomplaint (one row per ED stay). Sliced by subject_id.

multimodal/ed_vitalsign.csv.notes: 11 columns: temperature, heartrate, resprate, o2sat, sbp, dbp, rhythm, pain (multiple rows per ED stay; charttime + stay_id disambiguates). Sliced by subject_id.

multimodal/notes.csv.notes:
8 columns: note_id, subject_id, hadm_id, note_type, note_seq, charttime, storetime, text. Built by agent from note/{discharge, radiology} parent rows (sliced by hadm_id) + note/{discharge_detail, radiology_detail} detail rows (sliced by note_id). note_type codes: 'DS' = discharge summary, 'RR' = radiology report. Sliced by subject_id (via parent note_id → subject_id). text column carries full de-identified note body and may contain 
 and ___ placeholder markers.

_auxiliary_files._comment: summary.json is intentionally NOT in 'files'. scorer would error trying to extract columns from a JSON document, and load_evaluation_manifest would raise 'missing key configuration: summary.json'. summary.json stays in the source split tree (e.g. /Users/mac/Downloads/归档/N18_ckd_ED_notes_3000/summary.json) but is NOT copied into the reference/ tree used by the harness.

summary.json.expected_role: kept in source; not part of scoring

absent_files._comment: Files NOT present in N18 source that might be expected in other MIMIC-IV tasks.
absent_files.multimodal/ecg_manifest.csv: N18 source has no ECG; this file is omitted from 'files'.
absent_files.multimodal/ecg_measurements.csv: N18 source has no ECG; this file is omitted from 'files'.
